query_ground_truth.workflow_task: Audit and clean Pipedrive CRM data by exporting paginated leads and related records, then bulk-normalizing titles, organization names, duplicate organizations, deal and lead titles, lead labels, and custom-field data.
query_ground_truth.query: normalize deal and lead titles and labels
query_ground_truth.intent: Format and standardize deal titles, lead titles, and lead labels according to defined conventions.

toolkit_connection_statuses.description: Pipedrive is a sales management tool built around pipeline visualization, lead tracking, activity reminders, and automation to keep deals progressing
toolkit_connection_statuses.status_message: No Active connection for toolkit=pipedrive. You MUST call COMPOSIO_MANAGE_CONNECTIONS (toolkit="pipedrive") to create a connection BEFORE executing any pipedrive tools.

PIPEDRIVE_GET_ALL_LEAD_LABELS.description: Returns details of all lead labels. This endpoint does not support pagination and all labels are always returned.

PIPEDRIVE_UPDATE_A_LEAD_LABEL.description: Updates one or more properties of a lead label. Only properties included in the request will be updated.

id.description: The ID of the lead label

name.description: The name of the lead label

color.description: The color of the label. Only a subset of colors can be used.
